item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky declares that his country is ready to stop attacks on Russia - if the negotiating partners - guarantee that the Russians will refrain from damaging energy facilities, infrastructure, and food supply routes.

item.title: Strangling Iran: Will Trump’s endgame win out?
item.description: Will Washington tie its measures together so financial pressure becomes a noose that follows Iranian trade on the sea, in the air, through banks and possibly across land borders too? And makes the routes still left to Iran impossibly expensive?

item.title: Trump says he's 'open to the concept' of negotiations with Iran
item.description:
US President Donald Trump revealed on Monday that he is open to negotiations with Iran.
"The failing Nation of Iran wants to make a deal, quickly and badly. I will determine whether or not the U.S.A. will choose to engage - The concept of which we are open to," he wrote on Truth Social.

item.description: Macklemore is removed from eight Ed Sheeran tour dates after venues reportedly refused to host him following his ‘Free Palestine’ performances.

item.title: Following Attorney General’s intervention: Memorial event for Rabbi Ovadia Yosef canceled
item.description: The major event planned in memory of Rabbi Ovadia Yosef has been canceled following the Attorney General’s directive regarding the election period.

item.title: Security forces arrest Fatah terrorist in Tulkarm who planned attacks, trafficked weapons
item.description:
In a joint operation, the IDF and Shin Bet launched an operation today (Monday) to thwart terrorist activity in the Tulkarm area.
Following an intelligence and operational manhunt conducted over the past several weeks, security forces arrested Muhammad Ibrahim Abd al-Wahab Shahada, who was a senior Fatah terrorist operative in Tulkarm.
The terrorist operative had been wanted in recent months for his alleged involvement in terrorist activity, including the planning and execution of attacks and the trafficking of weapons.
